note: Provenance ledger for generated binaries that are NOT yet persisted to Google Drive. The architecture keeps binaries in Drive referenced from manifest.json by Drive file ID; until a Drive upload path exists (service-account credentials or a path-based upload tool), MCP renders are recorded here with full lineage so they are reproducible and traceable. When a render is uploaded to Drive, move it to manifest.json artifacts[] with its real driveFileId and delete its entry here.
driveUploadBlocker: The Google Drive create_file MCP tool only accepts inline base64 content as a parameter; multi-hundred-KB renders cannot be passed as tool arguments, and no service-account credentials are available for a direct Drive API upload from this environment.
